<mxfile host="Electron" agent="Codex"> <diagram id="verification-lifecycle" name="Verification lifecycle"> <mxGraphModel dx="-824" dy="-210" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="900" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=24;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#17324D;" value="Diagram Verification Lifecycle" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="620" x="60" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ui" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E8F1FB;strokeColor=#2F6DA5;fontColor=#17324D;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;" value="Root diagram UI
Verified ↔ Unverified switch" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="220" x="70" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="api" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E9F7EF;strokeColor=#2E8B57;fontColor=#17324D;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" value="Desired-state API
PATCH /verification
{ isVerified: Boolean }" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="250" x="370" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="guard" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DB;strokeColor=#C58A16;fontColor=#17324D;fontSize=14;" value="Owner check first

preserve | unverified" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="250" x="370" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="snapshot" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DB;strokeColor=#C58A16;fontColor=#17324D;fontSize=14;" value="Build snapshot copy

No follow-up /verify" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="250" x="370" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="created" parent="1" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;fillColor=#F3EAF8;strokeColor=#7A4EAB;fontColor=#17324D;fontSize=14;" value="Created root diagram
